    • 字段详细资料

      • backupId

        @NameInMap(value="BackupId")
public String backupId

        The ID of the cross-region backup set. You can call the DescribeCrossRegionBackups operation to query the ID.

        This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to 0.

        example:

        279563

      • clientToken

        @NameInMap(value="ClientToken")
public String clientToken

        The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters and cannot contain non-ASCII characters.

        example:

        ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz****

      • DBInstanceId

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceId")
public String DBInstanceId

        The instance ID of the existing instance to be recovered.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        rm-bp****

      • ownerId

        @NameInMap(value="OwnerId")
public Long ownerId

      • restoreTime

        @NameInMap(value="RestoreTime")
public String restoreTime

        The point in time to which you want to restore data. The specified point in time must be earlier than the current time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

        This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to 1.

        example:

        2020-04-25T16:00:00Z

      • restoreType

        @NameInMap(value="RestoreType")
public String restoreType

        The restoration method. Valid values:

        • 0: restores data based on a backup set. If you set this parameter to 0, you must also specify the BackupId parameter.
        • 1: restores data to a point in time. If you set this parameter to 1, you must also specify the RestoreTime, SourceRegion, and SourceDBInstanceName parameters.

        Default value: 0.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        0

      • sourceDBInstanceName

        @NameInMap(value="SourceDBInstanceName")
public String sourceDBInstanceName

        The instance ID of the source instance to recover data to a point in time.

        This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to 1.

        example:

        rm-bp****

      • sourceRegion

        @NameInMap(value="SourceRegion")
public String sourceRegion

        The ID of the source region for point-in-time restoration.

        This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to 1.

        example:

        cn-beijing

      • tableMeta

        @NameInMap(value="TableMeta")
public String tableMeta

        The databases and tables that you want to restore. Format: [{"type":"db","name":"<Name of database 1>","newname":"<New name of database 1>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<Name of table 1 in database 1>","newname":"<New name of table 1>"},{"type":"table","name":"<Name of table 2 in database 1>","newname":"<New name of table 2>"}]},{"type":"db","name":"<Name of database 2>","newname":"<New name of database 2>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<Name of table 3 in database 2>","newname":"<New name of table 3>"},{"type":"table","name":"<Name of table 4 in database 2>","newname":"<New name of table 4>"}]}]

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        [{"type":"db","name":"testdb1","newname":"testdb1","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"test1","newname":"test1_backup"},{"type":"table","name":"test2","newname":"test2_backup"}]}]
